def find_Max_Len_Even(input_string):
    # Split the input string into words
    words = input_string.split()
    
    # Filter out even length words
    even_length_words = [word for word in words if len(word) % 2 == 0]
    
    # Check if there are any even length words
    if not even_length_words:
        return -1
    
    # Find the maximum length among the filtered words
    max_length_word = max(even_length_words, key=len)
    
    return max_length_word
